title: Novel Antiphotoaging Peptides from Bovine Ligamentum Nuchae Proteins Hydrolysates: Based on Sprague-Dawley Rat Model and Molecular Docking.
authors: Li, Caihong; He, Jiaxin; Wu, Ruiqi; Cai, Luyun; Weng, Wuyin; Zhao, Mouming; Xu, Defeng
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该研究鉴定牛项韧带蛋白水解物中的抗光老化肽，并通过分子对接探讨其与MMP-1的结合，虽涉及分子对接但对象为肽-酶互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题TF-DNA研究无关。
abstract: This study identified novel antiphotoaging peptides from bovine ligamentum nuchae proteins hydrolysates (BLPs) and clarified their molecular mechanisms in photoaging SD rats. Initially, BLPs effectively alleviated photoaging manifestations. Biochemically, BLPs significantly reduced the oxidative stress and suppressed the phosphorylation levels of p38, JNK, and ERK in the mitogen-activated protein kinase pathway. Simultaneously, BLPs dramatically downregulated the hyperactivation of the nuclear factor kappa B pathway and reduced the inflammatory cytokines accordingly (P < 0.05). Moreover, two peptide fragments with the highest antioxidant capacity in separated fractions were identified with ultraperformance liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry, with the sequences of Gly-Leu-Pro-Tyr and Gly-Pro-Gly-Gly-Val-Gly-Ala-Leu. Subsequently, molecular docking revealed that the identified peptides established strong binding affinity to the four oxidation-sensitive cysteine residues in the active sites of MMP-1 mainly by hydrogen bonding and hydrophobic interactions. Collectively, this study demonstrates that BLPs exert potent photoprotection by synergistically targeting oxidative stress and MMP-1 active sites.
abstract_zh: 本研究从牛项韧带蛋白水解物（BLPs）中鉴定出新型抗光老化肽，并阐明了其在光老化SD大鼠中的分子机制。首先，BLPs有效缓解了光老化表现。在生化层面，BLPs显著降低了氧化应激，并抑制了丝裂原活化蛋白激酶通路中p38、JNK和ERK的磷酸化水平。同时，BLPs显著下调了核因子κB通路的过度激活，并相应减少了炎症细胞因子（P < 0.05）。此外，通过超高效液相色谱-串联质谱法，在分离组分中鉴定出两个抗氧化能力最高的肽片段，其序列分别为Gly-Leu-Pro-Tyr和Gly-Pro-Gly-Gly-Val-Gly-Ala-Leu。随后，分子对接揭示，所鉴定的肽主要通过氢键和疏水相互作用，与MMP-1活性位点中的四个氧化敏感半胱氨酸残基形成强结合亲和力。综上，本研究证明BLPs通过协同靶向氧化应激和MMP-1活性位点发挥强效光保护作用。
